summary: preinstall downloads the Bun runtime and executes a bundled obfuscated payload on install
details: On npm install, the package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a shipped ~727KB file math_init.js via execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js]). Both setup.mjs and math_init.js are heavily obfuscated (javascript-obfuscator-style _0xNNNN identifiers, string-array with index-permutation routine); no readable source is shipped. The executed payload is unrelated to the package's advertised 'card templates' SDK purpose. Using an alternate runtime to execute an opaque obfuscated bundle at install time yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine, and running under Bun bypasses Node-based instrumentation and scanning of the payload's behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
